Base-data interface: 2019-2020 records -> January 4 selection -> one-kilometre eastern-Victoria grid -> fire frequency/temperature/brightness score -> aligned elevation
Communication interface: free-space loss -> single-peak diffraction -> 18-18.5 km range -> SSA/front-line equivalence -> outbound/return time -> three-shift claim
Placement interface: scored fire cells -> EOC genetic search -> repeater genetic search -> distance-based two/three-airframe rule -> additive forward-team reach
Fleet interface: southeast wind -> 45-degree projected fire length -> three-shift SSA count -> 30 SSA + 24 repeaters -> 540,000 AUD
Extreme interface: 1938-2020 temperature -> LSTM -> dated fire-temperature join -> exponential fit -> 2698.14 -> 1.0884 map expansion -> 48/27 fleet -> 750,000 AUD
Terrain interface: October-January fire field + DEM -> high-mountain EOC constraint -> location-dependent repeater range -> optimized GA -> nine EOCs and sixteen coordinates
Evaluation interface: altitude sweep -> claimed stability -> strengths -> admitted future-fire weaknesses -> problem-wise conclusions -> Budget Request -> References and identity warning

main_argument_chains.claim: A procurement model is inspectable only when fire data, terrain, radio reach, schedules, locations, airframe roles, and costs pass typed outputs forward.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Maintain a machine-readable handoff ledger before accepting the 30/24 fleet.

main_argument_chains.claim: A weighted severity field supports coverage decisions only after weights, scales, outcome target, and uncertainty are auditable.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Treat W_xy as a paper-internal score until calibrated.

main_argument_chains.claim: Terrain-conditioned radio range requires a complete link budget and unambiguous diffraction relation, not only an approximate distance.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Use 18-18.5 km only as a source-specific planning value.

main_argument_chains.claim: Continuous SSA coverage is a scheduling property rather than a direct consequence of multiplying by three.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Simulate the duty timeline before purchasing three shifts.

main_argument_chains.claim: Genetic placement becomes decision evidence only with a closed objective, candidate set, feasibility rule, settings, seeds, repeated runs, and baseline.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Treat displayed EOC and repeater maps as internal heuristic outputs.

main_argument_chains.claim: Relay locations, simultaneously active roles, and total reserve airframes must remain distinct.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Resolve n_m semantics and the 13.5 km equality before cost accounting.

main_argument_chains.claim: A decade temperature forecast informs fire planning only through out-of-sample forecast evidence and a calibrated fire-response link.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Treat 2698.14 as a paper-internal scenario input.

main_argument_chains.claim: Uniform spatial expansion is a stress picture, not a mechanistic wildfire forecast.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Retain the 1.0884 rerun while avoiding physical-spread claims.

main_argument_chains.claim: The 750,000 AUD extreme total is arithmetically reproducible even though one printed component increase is wrong.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Separate arithmetic correction from validation of the scenario and fleet model.

main_argument_chains.claim: Terrain-aware coordinates require metric geometry, a coherent mountain rationale, solver provenance, constraint slacks, and measured radio feasibility.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Treat the sixteen regular points as unverified internal outputs.

main_argument_chains.claim: An altitude-only sweep shows local propagation response but cannot establish robustness of fleet or location decisions.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Reserve stability language for interaction-aware decision analysis.

main_argument_chains.claim: A stakeholder request is auditable only when technical quantities, exact arithmetic, quotations, lifecycle costs, implementation, uncertainty, and document identity reconcile.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: The paper supports a narrow 540,000 AUD base-airframe request, not a complete program budget.
